events.description: Judge Dredd's account was compromised; the attacker created an account named 'Judge Dredd Hacked' and posted a thread describing what he did. Omniscient confirmed the account was secured and recovered with no damage to HF.
Profile-stalking restrictions were extended from administrators to all staff members; nobody with a staff userbar can have their profile activity viewed.
Min.us image host has been blocked from HF after Avast added the domain to its blacklist.
The HF News team is recruiting for the first time; only two interviewer positions are open.
Interview with Tasemu conducted by Reported; covers his graphic design career, AARadio launch, and anime expertise.
Interview with Quantum. conducted by Reported; covers his moderator role, the Asskisser award, and signature advertising rates.
